invariants.rationale: The 'data' list is used directly and must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
The function 'func' is passed to a wrapper and must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
Parallelism is expected to be a positive integer for meaningful parallel execution.
'data' should be a List as per the method signature.
It is typical (though not required) to not have more parallelism than data elements to process.
